seoTitle: How to Enable Google Pay in Stripe (By Country)
metaDescription: Activate Google Pay in your Stripe dashboard and check whether your country supports it before accepting payments.
intro: Google Pay can make checkout faster for customers, but before turning it on you'll want to confirm your country supports it through Stripe. This guide covers how to activate Google Pay inside the Stripe dashboard, verify your payment settings, and test it before going live.

steps.heading: Check country eligibility
steps.body: Confirm that both your business location and your customers' regions are supported for Google Pay transactions through Stripe.

steps.heading: Open your Stripe dashboard
steps.body: Navigate to the payment methods section where you can enable Google Pay for your account.

steps.heading: Activate Google Pay
steps.body: Turn on Google Pay as an available payment method within your Stripe settings.

steps.heading: Verify your payment settings
steps.body: Double-check your checkout configuration to make sure Google Pay displays correctly to eligible customers.

steps.heading: Test and go live
steps.body: Run a test transaction with Google Pay to confirm it works, then start accepting real payments through it.

faq.question: Is Google Pay available in every country Stripe supports?
faq.answer: No, Google Pay support depends on both your business's country and the customer's region, so you should verify eligibility before relying on it.

faq.question: Do I need a Google account to enable Google Pay in Stripe?
faq.answer: No, Stripe handles the technical integration, so you don't need a separate Google merchant account just to enable it for customers.

faq.question: Can customers use Google Pay on any device?
faq.answer: Google Pay generally works on Android devices and in supported browsers, though availability can vary by device and browser.

faq.question: Does enabling Google Pay cost extra through Stripe?
faq.answer: Google Pay transactions are typically processed under your standard Stripe fees without an additional charge just for enabling the feature.
